full_reader.sql: Candidate page followed by grouped open stays for all movie and show candidates

live_bounds.sql: SELECT min(observed_at), max(observed_at), min(created_at), max(created_at) FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = 'US' AND appeared_source <> 'backfill'

reader_stays.sql: SELECT media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id, min(CASE WHEN appeared_source <> 'backfill' THEN (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) ELSE 0 END) FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = ? AND streaming_type IN (?, ?, ?) AND dropped_on IS NULL AND media_type = ? AND media_tmdb_id IN (?) GROUP BY media_tmdb_id, streaming_service_id LIMIT 1000000

all_live_days.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) AS day, count(*) AS live_stays, count(DISTINCT media_type || ':' || cast(media_tmdb_id AS TEXT)) AS titles FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = 'US' AND streaming_type IN ('flatrate','free','ads') AND appeared_source <> 'backfill' AND dropped_on IS NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

daily_arrivals.sql: SELECT date_trunc('day', arrived) AS day, count(*) AS live_stays, count(DISTINCT media_type || ':' || cast(media_tmdb_id AS TEXT)) AS titles FROM (SELECT media_type, media_tmdb_id, CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END AS arrived FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = 'US' AND streaming_type IN ('flatrate','free','ads') AND appeared_source <> 'backfill' AND dropped_on IS NULL AND (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) >= '2026-10-17T00:00:00Z') AS live GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1 LIMIT 1000

history_sources.sql: SELECT appeared_source, count(*) FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = 'US' GROUP BY appeared_source LIMIT 100

reader_candidates.sql: SELECT DISTINCT media_type, media_tmdb_id FROM availability_history WHERE country_code = ? AND streaming_type IN (?, ?, ?) AND dropped_on IS NULL AND appeared_source <> 'backfill' AND (CASE WHEN appeared_precision = 'exact' THEN appeared_on ELSE date_trunc('day', observed_at) END) > ? ORDER BY media_type, media_tmdb_id LIMIT 1000 OFFSET ?

scope: US flatrate/free/ads open stays; country-wide counts, before member saved-service filtering
explanation: All 164 live US stays currently date to October 16 under Q59. None has observed_at or created_at at or after the requested 00:13 UTC start. The daily_arrivals query includes all of October 17 (UTC day granularity).
